name: noriter-ai
description: Local AI Agent inside VSCode powered by LM Studio

noriter-ai.lmStudioEndpoint.description: LM Studio Local Server API Endpoint URL

noriter-ai.modelName.description: The identifier of the model loaded in LM Studio

noriter-ai.maxHistoryEntries.description: Maximum number of saved chat entries per workspace (user/assistant/error).

noriter-ai.maxContextMessages.description: How many recent saved user/assistant messages are sent to LM Studio as context.

noriter-ai.telegramBotToken.description: Telegram bot token used for sending messages (from @BotFather).

noriter-ai.telegramChatId.description: Telegram chat ID where the bot should send messages.

noriter-ai.telegramEnableChatBridge.description: When enabled, messages from the configured Telegram chat are processed by the local AI agent and replied back.
